steps.what: List survey dates already booked against the project.
Direct the survey work with the other project activities.
Coordinate the survey when the other work moves.

tasks.design: Survey dates already booked against the project are listed from {PROJECT}. The manager plans, directs, and coordinates the survey with the other activities. A survey with no date id is not listed. The list does not direct the survey.
tasks.previous_blocker: Survey dates were confirmed by calling the crew, and they clashed with other work already booked.
tasks.enabler_now: A booked survey date can be listed before the manager directs the crew.
tasks.still_hard: A site that is not ready on the booked date.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can hold the survey when the other activity has taken the ground.
tasks.altitude: Booked survey dates can be listed. The manager still directs the survey and still coordinates it with the other work.

reach.task: Read the booked survey date, and still leave the direction of the crew here.
reach.learn: The date can be listed. The survey stays here.

evidence.claim: A survey date already booked against the project can be listed. The list cannot plan, direct, or coordinate the survey.
The manager directs the crew. A date on a list is not the survey.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.
Fields: Survey id and date, produced by the booking log. A survey with no date is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the booking log the firm already keeps. The manager directs the crew.
unknowns: Which sites are not ready on the booked date.
research_questions: What share of surveys start from a booked date?
Which surveys move because other work took the ground?

already_counted.description: The manager still directs the survey.
The manager still coordinates when other work moves.

incremental.description: The manager books a survey the log did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing survey dates already booked against the project. It disappears when the date is missing and the manager books it. Directing and coordinating the survey stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Summarise environmental regulations already on the watch list.

loop.purpose: Read one regulation and write a short summary that cites only that text.
loop.input: The regulation text and its citation id.
loop.output: A summary in which each sentence names the citation.
loop.check: Each sentence is supported by the cited text.
loop.stop: The citation is missing, or a sentence states a duty the text does not contain.
loop.why_not_simpler: The regulation is continuous text, not typed fields, so a template cannot read the operative line. The loop stops when the citation is missing or a sentence is not in the text.

steps.what: Evaluate social pressures and inform the strategic or operational decision.
Record issues related to the decision the manager is making.

tasks.design: Environmental regulations already on the watch list are summarised in {DOCS} only when the citation is present, and the summary may not add a duty the text does not contain. The manager evaluates social pressures and makes the strategic or operational decision. A rule with no citation is not summarised. The summary does not decide.
tasks.previous_blocker: Regulations were pasted into a note, and a later meeting could not tell the text from the comment.
tasks.enabler_now: A regulation already on the watch list can be summarised against its citation before the manager decides.
tasks.still_hard: A social pressure that is not in the regulation, which the summary is not allowed to invent.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can decide that a correct summary still does not settle the operational question.
tasks.altitude: A cited regulation can be summarised. The manager still evaluates it and still makes the operational decision. The summary stops when the citation is missing.

reach.task: Pass a summary that cites the rule, and still leave the operational decision here.
reach.learn: The summary can be shared. The decision stays here.

evidence.claim: A regulation already on a watch list can be summarised when it has a citation. The summary stops if it states a duty the text does not contain.
The manager makes the strategic or operational decision. A summary is not that decision and it does not adopt a policy.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.
Fields: Citation id, produced by the watch list. A regulation with no citation is not summarised. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the watch list the firm already keeps. The summary may cite only the text it was given.
unknowns: Which regulations are already on the watch list.
Which decisions need a lawyer as well as the manager.
research_questions: What share of regulations on the list have a citation?
Which decisions turn on a pressure the text does not mention?

already_counted.description: The manager still evaluates the regulation and the pressure.
The manager still records the decision.

incremental.description: The manager adds a regulation the watch list did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is summarising environmental regulations already on the watch list, and only where the citation supports the sentence. It disappears when the citation is missing and the manager reads the text. The operational decision stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Seek support from officials and the public.

steps.what: Assemble the project facts already cleared for the public.
Solicit project support by conferring with officials.
Keep providing information to the public from the accepted note.

tasks.design: Project facts already cleared for the public are assembled in {DOCS}. The manager solicits support by conferring with officials and provides information to the public from that note. A fact that is not cleared is not assembled. The pack does not speak.
tasks.previous_blocker: Public questions were answered from memory, and a fact that was not cleared was sometimes included.
tasks.enabler_now: A fact already cleared can be assembled before the manager meets the official.
tasks.still_hard: A question the cleared facts do not answer, which the manager must not invent.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can say that a cleared pack does not answer the question just asked.
tasks.altitude: Cleared facts can be assembled. The manager still confers with officials and still speaks with the public. Nothing uncleared is in the pack.

reach.task: Use a pack of facts already cleared, and still hold the public conversation.
reach.learn: The pack can be shared. The conversation stays here.

evidence.claim: A project fact already cleared for the public can be assembled. The pack cannot confer with an official or solicit support.
The manager speaks with officials and the public. A fact that has not been cleared is not handed out, and the pack does not speak for the firm.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.

Fields: Fact id and a cleared flag, produced by the project file. A fact that is not cleared is not assembled. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the project file the firm already keeps. Do not post the pack to the public.
unknowns: Which meetings are with officials and which are public.
research_questions: What share of meetings start from cleared facts?
Which questions have no cleared answer?

already_counted.description: The manager still confers with officials.
The manager still provides information to the public.

incremental.description: The manager clears a fact the file did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is assembling project facts already cleared for the public. It disappears when the fact is not cleared and the manager clears it. Conferring with officials and speaking with the public stay with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager still directs the survey, still decides what a regulation means for the operation, and still speaks with officials and the public. A booked date or a cited rule can be listed first.
reach: Regulatory affairs managers read a cited rule and still make the operational decision, and this job learns a summary is not that decision.
Social and community service managers speak with the public themselves, and this job learns a fact pack is not that conversation.
skills_to_grow: Decide what a regulation means after the summary stops at the citation.
Confer with officials and the public in person.
role.ambitious_version: Booked survey dates and cited regulations are ready first. The survey, the operational decision, and the public conversation stay with the manager.
